_comment: The roster of record, in structured form. This is the machine-readable half of
your taste profile: config/taste.md explains the judgment, this file lists the
bands. Keep the two in sync — every band here should appear in taste.md's tier
Used by `npm run seed-board` to create the initial band rows. Once the board is
live, the board is the system of record and you curate tiers in the UI.
tier              1 = drop everything, 2 = would drive for it, 3 = curious.
Tier drives travel range and alert urgency, not whether a
lineup_qualifier  optional. A reunion without this person does not count as a
hit. Reported, but never routed as break-glass.
no_surface        optional. true for bands with no socials, no Bandcamp, no
website — usually because they ended before social media.
The 'dormant account wakes up' signal can never fire for
them, so the agent watches labels and members' other bands
instead, and caps their recheck cadence at monthly.

bands.name: <band that broke up and would be a genuine event>
<band with no online presence at all>
<band that only counts with a specific member>
<band that surfaces occasionally, worth a weeknight drive>
<small regional band — value is mostly proximity>
